_comment: Tools a box and a local registry both define with different callers or internal flags. The wider counts for reach-registry. Each needs a reason; the test fails on a new one.

tools.files.drive.status: box and local define it with different limits: the box one is open or wider (a read of counts or its own scoped shares), the Mac one forwards to the box with a callers list; the wider is counted
tools.link.status: box and local define it with different limits: the box one is open or wider (a read of counts or its own scoped shares), the Mac one forwards to the box with a callers list; the wider is counted
tools.chrome.snapshot: the box module admits a model caller whose claim hands-chrome checks (agentClaim, a named agent only); the Mac's own module lists the owner's agent label; the wider is counted
tools.chrome.open: the box module admits a model caller whose claim hands-chrome checks (agentClaim, a named agent only); the Mac's own module lists the owner's agent label; the wider is counted
tools.chrome.click: the box module admits a model caller whose claim hands-chrome checks (agentClaim, a named agent only); the Mac's own module lists the owner's agent label; the wider is counted
tools.chrome.type: the box module admits a model caller whose claim hands-chrome checks (agentClaim, a named agent only); the Mac's own module lists the owner's agent label; the wider is counted
tools.chrome.screenshot: the box module admits a model caller whose claim hands-chrome checks (agentClaim, a named agent only); the Mac's own module lists the owner's agent label; the wider is counted
tools.files.drive.audit: box and local define it with different limits: the box one admits a bare session and refuses a named agent in its body, the Mac one forwards over the link (the asker's identity is lost) with a person-only list; the wider is counted
